message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3157,"var":"c","code":"if (c != 3 && c != 1 && c != 4) return stbi__err(\"bad component count\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The 4-component CMYK frame is accepted, so the attacker-controlled sampling layout reaches the decode logic."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3173,"var":"z->img_comp[i].h","code":"z->img_comp[i].h = (q >> 4);  if (!z->img_comp[i].h || z->img_comp[i].h > 4) return stbi__err(\"bad H\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The SOF sampling byte is parsed directly from the file, allowing a crafted 4:4:4:4-style geometry."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3212,"var":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data","code":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data = stbi__malloc_mad2(z->img_comp[i].w2, z->img_comp[i].h2, 15);","note":"Per-component buffers are allocated from the crafted geometry and then reused by the later upsampler."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3759,"var":"r->hs","code":"r->hs      = z->img_h_max / z->img_comp[k].h;","note":"The horizontal scale factor is derived by integer division, so noncanonical sampling ratios collapse to discrete resampling cases."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3770,"var":"r->resample","code":"else                               r->resample = stbi__resample_row_generic;","note":"Any ratio outside the small set of special cases falls into the generic resampler rather than being rejected."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__resample_row_generic","line":3509,"var":"out[i*hs+j]","code":"out[i*hs+j] = in_near[i];","note":"The generic resampler writes expanded pixels using the attacker-derived factor; with inconsistent component geometry this can overrun the intended row boundary and trigger memory corruption."}
]
JSON
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
